استقرأت (form X)

# اِسْتَقْرَأْتَ (istaqraʔta) /is.taq.raʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# اِسْتَقْرَأْتِ (istaqraʔti) /is.taq.raʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# اِسْتَقْرَأَتْ (istaqraʔat) /is.t
